Package frc.robot.util

Class IKUpDownController

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj.GenericHID
frc.robot.util.IKUpDownController
public class IKUpDownController extends edu.wpi.first.wpilibj.GenericHID
A custom utility wrapper to handle keyboard inputs as a GenericHID for simulation.

Mimics a left and right joystick that can only move up and down, using IK and the Up/Down Arrow keys as axes, and UOJL as buttons (suggested for tank-style driving).
